text.tspan: FIRST-ORDER STATIC MODEL / NO WOOD GRADE OR CONNECTION CAPACITY HAS BEEN ASSIGNED
Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
02 / UPPER AND LOWER ACTIONS ON THE FRAME
Paired forces close through the frame. Vessel is outside this force loop.
Joint-to-joint span L_a is U; do not substitute speaking length.
P = sum(T_i) M_x = -sum(y_i T_i) M_y = sum(x_i T_i)

Signs shown for downward forces at the upper connection; lower forces reverse. A moved force requires the equivalent couple. Do not replace e with d/2 merely because a bracket touches the spine face. [W2]
A = b d I_x = b d^3/12 S_x = b d^2/6
Use measured net sections and both bending axes when needed. Holes, defects, moisture, grade,
bearing, restraint, creep and connection rotation remain part of review. Full 2 x 3 in and dressed 1.5 x
2.5 in sections are examples, not interchangeable stock.
Formula gives stress demand only; no allowable stress is selected here.
